name: Introduction to Programming with Python
description: First-semester computing fundamentals covering algorithmic thinking, variables, control flow, functions, modular program design, and basic data structures.
referenceBooks: Python Crash Course (3rd Edition) by Eric Matthes
Think Python: How to Think Like a Computer Scientist by Allen B. Downey (Open-Access)
Introduction to Computation and Programming Using Python by John V. Guttag (MIT Press)

units.title: Algorithmic Problem Solving & Python Basics
units.description: Computational thinking, Python interpreter, variables, dynamic types, arithmetic expressions, and standard I/O.

topics.title: Computational Thinking & Flow of Execution
Variables, Expressions, and Dynamic Data Types
Conditional Branching & Boolean Logic

units.title: Loops, Sequences & Data Collections
units.description: Iteration (while and for loops), strings, lists, tuples, and dictionary lookups.

topics.title: Iterative Loops (For, While) & Loop Invariants
List Operations, Slicing & Comprehensions
Dictionaries & Hash Key Mapping

units.title: Functions, Modular Design & Recursion
units.description: Function scopes, parameter passing, return values, recursion principles, and standard library modules.

topics.title: Modular Decomposition & Scope Invariants
Recursive Call Stacks & Base Case Guarantees

name: Data Structures and Algorithms
description: Foundational computing curriculum covering abstract data types, asymptotic efficiency analysis, linear data structures, tree hierarchies, graph algorithms, and sorting paradigms.
referenceBooks: Introduction to Algorithms (4th Edition) by Cormen, Leiserson, Rivest, Stein
Open Data Structures (in Pseudocode) by Pat Morin (Free Open-Access)
Data Structures & Algorithm Analysis in C++ by Mark Allen Weiss

units.title: Introduction to Data Structures
units.description: Abstract Data Types, Arrays, Memory layout, Time & Space Complexity, Asymptotic Analysis (Big-O, Omega, Theta).

topics.title: Abstract Data Types (ADT) and Primitive Structures
Asymptotic Notations (Big-O, Omega, Theta)
Worst, Average, and Amortized Time Complexity

units.title: Arrays, Linked Lists and Stacks
units.description: Singly, Doubly, and Circular Linked Lists, Pointer manipulation, Stack operations (Push/Pop), Expression conversion (Infix to Postfix).

topics.title: Singly & Doubly Linked List Pointer Operations
Stack Implementation via Arrays and Linked Lists
Infix to Postfix Conversion & Expression Evaluation

units.title: Queues and Trees
units.description: Linear & Circular Queues, Priority Queues, Binary Trees, Binary Search Tree (BST) property, Traversals (Inorder, Preorder, Postorder), AVL Tree balancing.

topics.title: Circular Queues and Priority Queues
Binary Search Tree (BST) Insertion and Deletion
AVL Trees and Self-Balancing Rotations

units.title: Graphs and Graph Algorithms
units.description: Graph representations (Adjacency Matrix & Lists), BFS, DFS, Dijkstra Single-Source Shortest Path, Minimum Spanning Trees (Prim and Kruskal).

topics.title: Adjacency Matrix vs Adjacency List Representations
Breadth-First Search (BFS) and Depth-First Search (DFS)
Dijkstra Shortest Path and Greedy Invariants

units.title: Sorting and Searching
units.description: Linear and Binary Search, Elementary sorts, Divide-and-Conquer: Merge Sort and Quick Sort, Heap Sort and Lower Bounds.

topics.title: Binary Search & Boundary Invariants
Merge Sort and Divide-and-Conquer Recurrence
Quick Sort Partitioning and Worst-Case Avoidance

name: Database Management Systems
description: Relational data modeling, SQL queries, relational calculus, schema normalization (1NF through BCNF), transaction processing, and ACID concurrency control.
referenceBooks: Database System Concepts (7th Edition) by Silberschatz, Korth, Sudarshan
Fundamentals of Database Systems by Elmasri and Navathe
Foundations of Databases by Abiteboul, Hull, Vianu (Alice Book - Open Access)

units.title: Introduction and Conceptual Modeling
units.description: Database architecture, 3-level schema, Entity-Relationship (ER) diagram modeling, keys and attributes.

topics.title: Database Architecture & Data Independence
Entity-Relationship (ER) Modeling

units.title: Relational Model and SQL
units.description: Relational algebra operations, SQL DDL, DML, complex joins, subqueries, and views.

topics.title: Relational Algebra Operators and Selection
Advanced SQL Joins and Aggregation

units.title: Relational Database Normalization
units.description: Functional dependencies, Armstrong axioms, 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, and Boyce-Codd Normal Form (BCNF).

topics.title: Functional Dependencies and Attribute Closures
Normalization to 3NF and BCNF Decompositions

units.title: Transaction Processing & ACID Properties
units.description: Transaction states, ACID guarantees, serializability, conflict serializability, two-phase locking (2PL).

topics.title: ACID Properties and Transaction Lifecycle
Concurrency Control and Strict Two-Phase Locking

name: Computer Networks and Protocols
description: Comprehensive study of computer networking architectures, OSI 7-layer model, TCP/IP protocol suite, data link framing, routing algorithms, transport layer flow control, and network security.
referenceBooks: Computer Networking: A Top-Down Approach by Kurose and Ross
Computer Networks (5th Edition) by Andrew S. Tanenbaum
TCP/IP Illustrated, Volume 1: The Protocols by W. Richard Stevens

units.title: Network Architecture & Physical Layer
units.description: Network edge and core, packet switching vs circuit switching, OSI 7-layer reference model, TCP/IP stack, transmission media, and delay/loss bounds.

topics.title: OSI 7-Layer Model vs TCP/IP Protocol Stack
Packet Switching vs Circuit Switching & Statistical Multiplexing
Transmission Media, Propagation Delay & Throughput Bounds

units.title: Data Link Layer & Local Area Networks
units.description: Framing, error detection and correction (Parity, Checksum, CRC), flow control protocols, multiple access (CSMA/CD, CSMA/CA), and Ethernet switching.

topics.title: Framing Techniques & Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) Error Detection
Sliding Window Flow Control Protocols (Stop-and-Wait, Go-Back-N, Selective Repeat)
Carrier Sense Multiple Access (CSMA/CD) & Collision Avoidance

units.title: Network Layer & Routing Protocols
units.description: Virtual circuit vs datagram networks, IP addressing (IPv4, IPv6, Subnetting, CIDR), NAT, routing algorithms (Dijkstra Link-State, Bellman-Ford Distance Vector), BGP, and OSPF.

topics.title: IPv4 / IPv6 Hierarchical Addressing, Subnetting & CIDR Calculation
Dijkstra Link-State vs Bellman-Ford Distance Vector Routing
Intra-AS & Inter-AS Routing Paradigms (OSPF, RIP, and BGP)

units.title: Transport Layer & Congestion Control
units.description: Multiplexing and demultiplexing, UDP connectionless delivery, TCP 3-way handshake, connection teardown, TCP reliable data transfer, flow control, and TCP Reno/Tahoe congestion control.

topics.title: User Datagram Protocol (UDP) Architecture & Checksum Verification
TCP 3-Way Handshake, Connection Teardown & Sequence Tracking
TCP Congestion Control (Slow Start, Additive Increase, Multiplicative Decrease)

units.title: Application Layer & Network Security
units.description: DNS resolution hierarchy, HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 vs HTTP/3, SMTP email architecture, symmetric/asymmetric encryption, SSL/TLS handshakes, and firewall architectures.

topics.title: Domain Name System (DNS) Hierarchical Architecture & Query Caching
HyperText Transfer Protocol Evolution (HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3 QUIC)
SSL/TLS Cryptographic Handshake & Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)

name: Object-Oriented Programming
description: Core paradigms of object-oriented software development including data abstraction, encapsulation, inheritance, dynamic polymorphism, interface contracts, robust exception handling, generic collections, and stream-based I/O processing.
referenceBooks: Java: The Complete Reference (12th Edition) by Herbert Schildt (McGraw Hill)
Effective Java (3rd Edition) by Joshua Bloch (Addison-Wesley)
Head First Java (3rd Edition) by Kathy Sierra, Bert Bates, Trisha Gee (O'Reilly)
Object-Oriented Programming with C++ (8th Edition) by E. Balagurusamy (McGraw Hill)

units.title: Foundations of Object-Oriented Paradigm & Class Design
units.description: Procedural vs object-oriented design, encapsulation, classes, object lifecycle, constructors, method overloading, and the this reference.

topics.title: Principles of OOP: Abstraction, Encapsulation & Modularity
Class Syntax, State Representation & Object Instantiation
Constructors, Overloading & Reference Lifecycle Management

units.title: Inheritance, Subtyping & Dynamic Polymorphism
units.description: Class hierarchies, code reuse, method overriding, super keyword, dynamic method dispatch, abstract classes, and pure virtual contracts.

topics.title: Single, Multilevel & Hierarchical Inheritance Hierarchies
Method Overriding vs Overloading & Dynamic Method Dispatch
Abstract Base Classes, Pure Virtual Contracts & Sealed Types

units.title: Interfaces, Packages & Namespace Modularity
units.description: Interface definitions, multiple inheritance of type, default/static methods, package namespaces, access control specifiers, and static immutability.

topics.title: Interface Contracts & Decoupled Architecture Implementation
Package Namespace Organization & Access Specifiers (Public, Private, Protected)
Static Class Members, Final Invariants & Immutability Patterns

units.title: Exception Handling, Stream I/O & File Processing
units.description: Checked and unchecked exceptions, try-catch-finally mechanisms, custom exception types, resource management (try-with-resources), and character/byte streams.

topics.title: Exception Hierarchy: Checked vs Unchecked Runtime Exceptions
Robust Error Handling with Try-Catch-Finally & Custom Exceptions
Byte and Character Streams, File I/O & Object Serialization

units.title: Generics, Collections Framework & Concurrency Basics
units.description: Generic programming, type parameters, Java Collection Framework (List, Set, Map), iterators, thread lifecycle, and basic synchronization.

topics.title: Generic Classes, Type Parameters & Invariance Guarantees
Collections Framework: ArrayList, LinkedList, HashSet, HashMap
Multi-threading Foundations: Thread Lifecycle & Synchronization Locks

name: Computer Organization and Architecture
description: Comprehensive analysis of modern computer hardware systems, instruction set architecture (ISA), arithmetic logic unit design, processor datapath, pipelining hazards, cache memory hierarchy, and I/O bus interfaces.
referenceBooks: Computer Organization and Architecture (11th Edition) by William Stallings (Pearson)
Computer System Architecture (3rd Edition) by M. Morris Mano (Pearson)
Computer Architecture: A Quantitative Approach (6th Edition) by Hennessy and Patterson (Morgan Kaufmann)

units.title: Digital Logic Foundations & Register Transfer
units.description: Data representations, fixed and IEEE 754 floating point arithmetic, register transfer language (RTL), bus structures, and micro-operations.

topics.title: Fixed-Point, Two's Complement & IEEE 754 Floating-Point Formats
Register Transfer Language (RTL) & Bus Transfer Invariants
Arithmetic, Logic & Shift Micro-operations and ALU Design

units.title: Central Processing Unit & Instruction Set Architecture
units.description: CPU organization, register sets, instruction formats, addressing modes, instruction cycle (fetch, decode, execute), CISC vs RISC paradigms.

topics.title: Instruction Fetch, Decode, Execute Cycle & Interrupts
Instruction Set Architectures & Addressing Modes (Immediate, Direct, Indirect, Indexed)
RISC vs CISC Architectural Design Trade-offs

units.title: Processor Pipelining & Control Unit Design
units.description: Hardwired vs microprogrammed control units, instruction pipelining, pipeline throughput, structural, data, and control hazard resolution.

topics.title: Hardwired Control vs Microprogrammed Control Unit Architecture
Instruction Pipelining Stages & Speedup Bounds
Pipelining Hazards (Data Dependencies, Branch Penalties) & Forwarding

units.title: Memory Hierarchy & Cache Memory Architectures
units.description: Memory hierarchy principles, locality of reference, semiconductor RAM/ROM, cache mappings (direct, associative, set-associative), and replacement algorithms.

topics.title: Memory Hierarchy Principles & Locality of Reference (Spatial vs Temporal)
Cache Mapping Functions: Direct, Associative, and Set-Associative Mapping
Cache Replacement Policies (LRU, FIFO) & Write-Through vs Write-Back Strategies

units.title: Input-Output Organization & Bus Interfacing
units.description: Peripheral devices, I/O interfaces, asynchronous data transfer, programmed I/O, interrupt-driven I/O, and Direct Memory Access (DMA).

topics.title: Programmed I/O vs Interrupt-Driven I/O Mechanisms
Direct Memory Access (DMA) Controllers & Bus Arbitration
Standard Peripheral Interfaces & System Interconnect Protocols (PCIe, USB)

name: Operating Systems
description: Exploration of computer operating system architecture, process management, multi-threading, CPU scheduling algorithms, process synchronization, deadlock handling, memory management, virtual memory paging, and file storage systems.
referenceBooks: Operating System Concepts (10th Edition) by Silberschatz, Galvin, and Gagne (Wiley)
Modern Operating Systems (5th Edition) by Andrew S. Tanenbaum and Herbert Bos (Pearson)
Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces by Remzi H. Arpaci-Dusseau and Andrea C. Arpaci-Dusseau (Free Online)

units.title: Operating System Structures & System Calls
units.description: OS services, user and operating-system interfaces, system calls, system programs, OS design and implementation (monolithic, layered, microkernel), and virtualization.

topics.title: OS Services, Dual-Mode Operation (User/Kernel) & Trap Mechanisms
System Calls, Parameter Passing & API Execution Pipelines
Monolithic, Layered, Microkernel & Modular OS Architectures

units.title: Process Management & CPU Scheduling
units.description: Process concepts, Process Control Block (PCB), context switching, thread models, multi-core programming, CPU scheduling criteria, and scheduling algorithms.

topics.title: Process Control Block (PCB), Process State Transitions & Context Switching
Threads, Multithreading Models & Kernel vs User-Level Threads
CPU Scheduling Algorithms: FCFS, SJF, Round Robin & Priority Scheduling

units.title: Process Synchronization & Deadlocks
units.description: Critical section problem, Peterson's solution, synchronization hardware, mutex locks, semaphores, monitors, classical synchronization problems, and deadlock characterization, prevention, avoidance (Banker's), and detection.

topics.title: Critical Section Problem, Race Conditions & Peterson's Solution
Counting & Binary Semaphores, Mutex Locks and Monitors
Classical IPC Problems: Producer-Consumer, Dining Philosophers & Readers-Writers
Deadlock Characterization, Prevention & Banker's Avoidance Algorithm

units.title: Main Memory & Virtual Memory Management
units.description: Memory management hardware, address binding, logical vs physical addresses, contiguous allocation, paging, segmentation, demand paging, page replacement algorithms, and thrashing.

topics.title: Logical vs Physical Address Spaces, MMU & Contiguous Memory Allocation
Paging Architecture, Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB) & Page Tables
Virtual Memory, Demand Paging & Page Fault Servicing
Page Replacement Algorithms (FIFO, Optimal, LRU) & Thrashing Invariants

units.title: Storage Management & File Systems
units.description: File concept, access methods, directory structures, file allocation methods (contiguous, linked, indexed), free-space management, disk structure, and disk scheduling algorithms.

topics.title: File Concepts, Directory Organizations & Access Control Lists (ACL)
File System Allocation Methods: Contiguous, Linked & Indexed Allocation
Disk Scheduling Algorithms: FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN & RAID Architectures

name: Software Engineering
description: Principles, methodologies, and tools for systematic software development across the entire lifecycle: process models, Agile frameworks, requirements engineering, architectural modeling, modular design, software testing, quality assurance, and modern DevOps CI/CD practices.
referenceBooks: Software Engineering: A Practitioner's Approach (9th Edition) by Roger S. Pressman and Bruce R. Maxim (McGraw Hill)
Software Engineering (10th Edition) by Ian Sommerville (Pearson)

The Pragmatic Programmer: Your Journey to Mastery (20th Anniversary Edition) by David Thomas and Andrew Hunt

units.title: Software Process Models & Agile Methodologies
units.description: Software engineering paradigm, software crises, linear sequential (Waterfall), incremental, evolutionary (Spiral) models, and Agile philosophies (Scrum, Kanban, Extreme Programming).

topics.title: Software Engineering Lifecycles & SDLC Phase Invariants
Traditional Process Models: Waterfall, Prototyping, Incremental & Spiral
Agile Software Development: Scrum Ceremonies, Sprints, User Stories & Kanban

units.title: Requirements Engineering & Analysis Modeling
units.description: Requirements inception, elicitation, negotiation, specification (SRS IEEE 830), functional vs non-functional requirements, use-case modeling, and UML activity/sequence diagrams.

topics.title: Requirements Elicitation, Stakeholder Analysis & IEEE 830 SRS Documentation
Functional vs Non-Functional Requirements & Traceability Matrices
UML Conceptual Modeling: Use-Case Diagrams, Activity & Sequence Diagrams

units.description: Software architectural patterns (Layered, Client-Server, Event-Driven, Microservices), modular design principles, cohesion, coupling, and Gang of Four (GoF) design patterns.

Modularity Metrics: High Cohesion and Loose Coupling Invariants
Object-Oriented Design Patterns: Creational, Structural & Behavioral (GoF)

units.title: Software Verification, Validation & Testing
units.description: Verification vs validation, black-box testing, white-box testing, cyclomatic complexity, unit testing, integration strategies, and automated regression testing.

topics.title: Black-Box Testing: Equivalence Partitioning & Boundary Value Analysis
White-Box Testing: Control Flow Graphs, Basis Path Testing & Cyclomatic Complexity
Testing Hierarchy: Unit, Integration (Top-Down/Bottom-Up), System & Acceptance Testing

units.title: Software Quality Assurance, Maintenance & DevOps
units.description: Software quality assurance (SQA), ISO 9001, CMMI process capability, code refactoring, technical debt, version control with Git, and CI/CD pipelines.

topics.title: Software Quality Assurance (SQA), Metrics & CMMI Maturity Levels
Software Maintenance Categories (Corrective, Adaptive, Perfective) & Refactoring
